narr: Thunderstorms during the afternoon and early evening of April 15 produced locally heavy rain in New Jersey. Rainfall totals were as high as 2.0 to 3.5 inches.
ev: US Route 1 southbound was closed in South Brunswick Township due to flooding.
Larchmont Boulevard in Mount Laurel Township was closed at Willow Turn due to flooding. The water was up to 2 or 3 feet deep and one vehicle became stranded.
Minor flooding occurred along the Neshanic River and its tributaries in Raritan Township.
lsr: LARCHMONT BOULEVARD CLOSED AT WILLOW TURN DUE TO FLOODING. A VEHICLE WAS STRANDED AND THERE WAS 2 TO 3 FEET OF WATER ON THE ROADWAY.
